directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors

orderOnlyCorrections.note: Same stroke directions at every index, so the probe stayed silent; the reorders (small 人 before 大 in 夾, inner bars before the middle vertical in 馬) were found in the stage-by-stage visual review and confirmed against endpoint coordinates.

subThresholdSlants.note: Short dots the dictionary draws vertically while the licensed corpora slant them, below the inspection threshold. Kept as licensed geometry, as in batches 1 to 15. The left 火 dot of 熒 (stroke 1, 52°) is also retained below threshold while its flagged siblings (5, 11) were mirrored.

sourceTransform.note: serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y); the offset does not change stroke directions.
